description: `cli service guide --help` prints its generated topic. Generated by ci/render_service_help.py --write.

stdout.text:
Usage: prose [GLOBAL OPTIONS] cli service guide [OPTIONS]

Print the agent guide: grammar, key precedence, confirmation, exit codes with resume and detach, paging, reading a run's answer and recipes. Makes no request.

Options:
  --json                      Print one JSON result; the same as the global --output json.
  --help                      Show help for this command.

Examples:
  prose cli service guide
  prose cli service guide --json

Output: the guide as Markdown (shared/service/guide.v1.md); with --json, its sections as openprose.service-operation/1 result {sections: [{id, title, body}]}.
Exit codes: 0 success; 2 invalid invocation or configuration.
